description: Make a call owned by the authenticated user public or private. Calls are private by default. Only publish when the user explicitly asks: a public call exposes its objective, phone numbers, transcript, result and audio to anyone with its permanent, token-free listen_url, including live audio while in progress. Set is_public to false to disable token-free access again; existing private signed links remain valid until they expire. Public visitors cannot stop the call or change visibility.

call_id.description: The id of a call owned by this account.

is_public.description: true publishes the call; false makes it private again.

name: set_call_visibility

call_id.description: Call identifier used with get_call, end_call and set_call_visibility.

is_public.description: Updated visibility; public links expose call data.

listen_url.description: URL for the user to listen, read the transcript and stop an active call.

outputSchema.description: Successful result or a machine-readable tool error.
